title: String methods check
instructions: Five questions on string methods and f-strings.

questions.explanation: split cuts the string at every comma and returns a list of the pieces.
There are three letter a's in banana.

questions.prompt: After s = 'hi' and the line s.upper(), what does print(s) show?
questions.explanation: Strings cannot be changed. upper() returns a new string, and the result was thrown away, so s is still 'hi'.
.2f formats a float with exactly two decimal places.
find returns -1 when the text is not found. Note that 0 would mean it was found at the very start.
